name: qa-defect-management
description: Defect management: severity vs priority classification, bug tracker workflows on Jira, Linear, GitHub Issues and Azure DevOps, and fix confirmation. Agents (ci-defect-filer, defect-fix-verifier) turn CI failures into deduplicated tracker bugs and re-run a defect's reproduction once a fix is claimed. Distinct from qa-bug-repro, which covers reproduction, report authoring, and the weekly defect review.
